question: Why is pink cocaine likelier to cause overdose than a pure drug?
answer: Pink cocaine is a mix, so no user knows what is inside or how much. Three pinches of the same pink powder can hold very different amounts of a potent opioid like fentanyl, and you can't tell which has the least. Because the dose is unknown, it is easy to take too much, and an overdose can kill.
move: In an unknown mix, you can't know your dose of anything.
